faq.q: Is there a free Vampire Survivors browser demo?
faq.a: Yes. poncle hosts an old v0.2.4 demo on itch.io. It is not the current game and its save does not move to Steam.

faq.q: Why will my weapon not evolve?
faq.a: The weapon needs its listed level, the matching passive in your inventory and a chest that can award an evolution. Some later recipes need the passive at maximum level.

faq.q: How do I unlock the Infinite Corridor?
faq.a: Follow the Yellow Sign prerequisites, then get both rings and Clock Lancet at the right levels.

faq.q: Which DLC should I buy first?
faq.a: Choose by the run you want: the DLC guide compares the gameplay packs by theme and shows which are free.

faq.q: Can I play Vampire Survivors with a friend?
faq.a: The full game supports local and online co-op, but compatibility depends on both storefronts. Check the pair before buying a second copy.
